title: Global finite scalar models under normalized finite-discrete encoding
statement: For finite discrete commutative A and a scheme T, an internal module M is the scalar constant extension of a finitely presented scalar module if and only if its normalized fixed-module encoding is a constant sheaf of a finite A-module. Definitions and encodings are those of [lem-sf-finite-discrete-normalized-encoding], [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model].

source.place: Second paragraph: the finite-stalk constructibility convention used for all quotient coefficients.

proof.text: Constant functions identify A with the continuous functions from the one-point profinite set. Internal modules in abelian groups identify scalar modules with ordinary A-modules.

The scalar coefficient map is the constant-sheaf counit. Its composite with constant functions is the normalized coefficient identification, so it is invertible. Restriction and extension of scalars along it are inverse equivalences.

Over finite A, a finite free presentation has finite cokernel. Conversely the free module on a finite module surjects onto it with finite kernel, giving a finite presentation. Transport finite free sums and cokernels through scalar encoding.

A proved equality compares the monoid structure from the composed constant-sheaf functor with ring-presheaf sheafification. Identity scalar restriction transports between them. Module sheafification and the monoidal constant-sheaf comparison then identify scalar extension, after encoding, with the constant sheaf of the encoded scalar module. Full faithfulness transports model isomorphisms in both directions.

theorem finite_scalar_model_iff_constant [Finite A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (e : Encoding A T) (M : Internal A T) :
    (∃ Q : Mod Ab.{u + 1} (scalarRingObj (coefficient A)),
      Mod.IsFinitelyPresented (scalarRingObj (coefficient A)) Q ∧
      Nonempty (M ≅ (finiteConstantScalarExtension (coefficient A) T).obj Q)) ↔
    ∃ P : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A), Finite P ∧
      Nonempty ((e.ordinary.functor ⋙ e.fixed.functor).obj M ≅
        (constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A))).obj P)
